name: Ducky
author: FranjeGueje
description: Frame generation profiles for lsfg-vk: edit them and choose one per game.

profile.label: Multiplier
profile.hint: Frames shown for every real frame: 2 doubles the frame rate, 3 triples it. Higher values add latency and artifacts.

profile.label: Flow scale
profile.hint: Resolution used to estimate motion between frames. Lower is lighter on the GPU but less precise; 1.0 is full quality.

profile.label: Performance mode
profile.hint: Uses a lighter frame generation model: faster, with slightly lower quality. Useful on handhelds.

profile.label: Pacing
profile.hint: How generated frames are paced on screen. VSync is the only mode lsfg-vk offers today.

profile.label: Override present mode
profile.hint: Lets lsfg-vk choose the presentation mode it needs instead of the game's. Turn off only if a game misbehaves.

profile.label: Preserve swapchain image count
profile.hint: Keeps the game's own number of swapchain images. Only for games that fail to start or stutter with frame generation.

global.label: Allow FP16
global.hint: Lets frame generation use half precision where the GPU supports it, which is usually faster. Turn off only to troubleshoot.

global.label: Log level
global.hint: How much lsfg-vk writes to its log. Info is enough; Debug helps when reporting a problem.

global.label: Lossless.dll path
global.hint: Where Lossless.dll is. Leave empty to let lsfg-vk find it in your Lossless Scaling installation.
